claims: Generation Z typically refers to individuals born between 1997 and 2012.
Generation Z is often called Zoomers.
Generation Z members are aged approximately 12–27 as of 2024.
The most common range for Generation Z is 1997–2012.
Some researchers suggest 1996-2015 as a range for Generation Z, as shown in the YouTube video.
Some researchers suggest mid-to-late 1990s as a start and early 2010s as an end for Generation Z, as shown in the YouTube video.
The Wikipedia article states that Generation Z is the first to grow up with internet and digital technology as an established norm.
The Wikipedia article states that Generation Z has high usage of mobile devices, social media, and digital platforms.
The Wikipedia article states that Generation Z has a focus on education, financial security, and social consciousness.
Generation Z members are largely children of Generation X, as shown on the Wikipedia website.
